russell:1897.author: Bertrand A. W. Russell
russell:1897.work: An Essay on the Foundations of Geometry
russell:1897.note: First edition (xvi + 201 pp.); revised expansion of Russell's 1895 Trinity Fellowship dissertation. Public domain (Project Gutenberg #52091).

russell:1903.author: Bertrand Russell
russell:1903.work: The Principles of Mathematics, Vol. I
russell:1903.note: First edition (xxix + 534 pp.), containing Part I (The Indefinables of Mathematics) and Part VI (Space, Chs. XLIV–LII, §§351–436, pp. 371–461).

russell:1899:axioms.author: Bertrand Russell
russell:1899:axioms.work: Sur les axiomes de la géométrie
russell:1899:axioms.locus: Revue de Métaphysique et de Morale 7, pp. 684–707
russell:1899:axioms.note: Russell's French exchange with Henri Poincaré marking his transition from the 1897 Essay toward Peano–Pieri axiomatics.

russell:1902:britannica.author: Bertrand Russell
russell:1902:britannica.locus: Encyclopaedia Britannica, 10th ed., Vol. XXVIII (Vol. IV of New Volumes), pp. 664–674
russell:1902:britannica.note: Cited by T. L. Heath in Euclid's Elements Vol. I, p. 227 on motion in geometry as transference of attention.

russell:1911:rmm.author: Bertrand Russell
russell:1911:rmm.locus: Bulletin de la Société française de Philosophie / Revue de Métaphysique et de Morale
russell:1911:rmm.note: Cited by P. Hoenen in De Noetica Geometriae Caput III, §2.6.B on Cantorian point-set continua.

whitehead-russell:1910.author: Alfred North Whitehead & Bertrand Russell
whitehead-russell:1910.locus: Cambridge: At the University Press (``*2.01``, p. 100)
whitehead-russell:1910.note: Formal symbolic execution of the logicist program announced in PoM (1903); analyzed by Hoenen in Caput V, §4.2.B.

hoenen:1954.author: Petrus H. J. Hoenen, S.J.
hoenen:1954.work: De Noetica Geometriae: Origine Theoriae Cognitionis
hoenen:1954.locus: Analecta Gregoriana Vol. LXIII, Rome: Pontificia Universitas Gregoriana
hoenen:1954.note: Thomistic epistemological treatise engaging Russell's PoM §§389–391 in Caput IV (§§2–3, §7) and Russell's continuum/logicism in Caput III & V.

euclid:elements:i-1.author: Euclid (trans. Sir Thomas L. Heath)
euclid:elements:i-1.work: The Thirteen Books of Euclid's Elements
euclid:elements:i-1.note: Equilateral triangle construction critiqued in PoM §389 for assuming two-circle intersection without an explicit continuity postulate.

euclid:elements:i-4.author: Euclid (trans. Sir Thomas L. Heath)
euclid:elements:i-4.work: The Thirteen Books of Euclid's Elements
euclid:elements:i-4.note: Side-Angle-Side congruence by superposition; locus of Russell's PoM §§390–391 critique, Heath's p. 249 commentary, and Hoenen's Caput IV §§2–3 defense.

pappus:collection:vii.author: Pappus of Alexandria
pappus:collection:vii.note: Ancient projective lemmas underlying Desargues, Chasles, von Staudt, and Russell's projective chapters (geometor/pappus).

kant:1787:krv.author: Immanuel Kant
kant:1787:krv.work: Kritik der reinen Vernunft (Critique of Pure Reason, 2nd ed.)
kant:1787:krv.note: Target of Russell's critical reconstruction in EFG Ch. II (§§51–58) and logicist refutation in PoM Ch. LII (§§432–436).

staudt:1847.author: Karl Georg Christian von Staudt
staudt:1847.work: Geometrie der Lage (and Beiträge zur Geometrie der Lage, 1856–1860)
staudt:1847.note: Purely synthetic foundation of harmonic conjugates via the complete quadrilateral construction without metrical cross-ratios.

cayley:1859.author: Arthur Cayley
cayley:1859.locus: Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society of London 149, pp. 61–90
cayley:1859.note: Introduced the projective theory of distance relative to the Absolute conic/quadric.

klein:1871.author: Felix Klein
klein:1871.work: Über die sogenannte Nicht-Euklidische Geometrie (and Vorlesungen über Nicht-Euklidische Geometrie, 1893)
klein:1871.note: Unified hyperbolic, elliptic, and parabolic geometries under Cayley's projective metric.

riemann:1854.author: Bernhard Riemann
riemann:1854.work: Über die Hypothesen, welche der Geometrie zu Grunde liegen
riemann:1854.locus: Abhandlungen der Königlichen Gesellschaft der Wissenschaften zu Göttingen 13
riemann:1854.note: Introduced n-dimensional manifolds, the quadratic differential metric ds², and spaces of constant curvature.

helmholtz:1868.author: Hermann von Helmholtz
helmholtz:1868.work: Über die Thatsachen, die der Geometrie zum Grunde liegen
helmholtz:1868.locus: Nachrichten von der Kgl. Gesellschaft der Wissenschaften zu Göttingen, pp. 193–221
helmholtz:1868.note: Formulated the free-mobility and rigid-body derivation of constant-curvature metrics.

pasch:1882.author: Moritz Pasch
pasch:1882.note: Axiomatized descriptive geometry, linear betweenness, planar separation (Pasch's axiom), and ideal elements.

peano:1889.author: Giuseppe Peano
peano:1889.work: I principii di geometria logicamente esposti (and Sui fondamenti della geometria, 1894)
peano:1889.locus: Turin: Fratelli Bocca / Rivista di Matematica 4, pp. 51–90
peano:1889.note: Symbolic axiomatization of descriptive and metrical geometry studied in PoM Chs. XLVI–XLVII.

pieri:1898.author: Mario Pieri
pieri:1898.work: I principii della geometria di posizione composti in sistema logico deduttivo
pieri:1898.locus: Memorie della Reale Accademia delle Scienze di Torino (2) 48, pp. 1–62
pieri:1898.note: Hypothetico-deductive axiomatization of projective geometry adopted by Russell throughout PoM Ch. XLV.

hilbert:1899.author: David Hilbert
hilbert:1899.locus: Festschrift zur Feier der Enthüllung des Gauss-Weber-Denkmals in Göttingen, Leipzig: Teubner
hilbert:1899.note: Modern axiomatic reconstruction of Euclidean geometry cited by Russell (PoM §§375, 390–391), Heath, and Hoenen.

lotze:1879.author: Rudolf Hermann Lotze
lotze:1879.work: Metaphysik: Drei Bücher der Ontologie, Kosmologie und Psychologie
lotze:1879.locus: Leipzig: S. Hirzel (Book II, Ch. II, §§108–137)
lotze:1879.note: Source of the anti-metageometrical and anti-relational arguments examined in EFG §§85–96 and PoM §§424–428.

erdmann:1877.author: Benno Erdmann
erdmann:1877.work: Die Axiome der Geometrie: Eine philosophische Untersuchung der Riemann-Helmholtz'schen Raumtheorie
erdmann:1877.note: Empiricist treatise on Riemann–Helmholtz geometry critiqued in EFG §§74–84.

whitehead:1898.author: Alfred North Whitehead
whitehead:1898.work: A Treatise on Universal Algebra, with Applications, Vol. I
whitehead:1898.note: Source for Russell's discussion of complex numbers, Grassmann's Ausdehnungslehre, and projective metrics in PoM Chs. XLIV & XLVIII.

hardy:1929.author: G. H. Hardy
hardy:1929.note: Cited by Hoenen (Caput V, §3.2.A n. 8) regarding Russell's logistic proof of 2 + 2 = 4 vs. mathematical intuition.
